[{"name": "code_family_age", "idea": "Days since the first sale of the article's whole product_code family, which separates truly new models from new colourways of long-running models that ag_age_days treats the same.", "level": "article", "sql": "WITH f AS (SELECT a.product_code, MIN(t.t_dat) AS d FROM tx t JOIN articles a ON t.article_id = a.article_id GROUP BY a.product_code) SELECT a.article_id, date_diff('day', f.d, DATE '{A}') AS ag_code_age_days FROM articles a JOIN f ON f.product_code = a.product_code;"},
{"name": "item_rebuy_conversion7", "idea": "Smoothed share of the article's distinct buyers in [A-14, A-7) who bought it again in [A-7, A), a short-horizon repurchase rate that matches the one-week label better than the 90-day repeat share.", "level": "article", "sql": "WITH p AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, article_id FROM tx WHERE t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND t_dat < DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY), q AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id, article_id FROM tx WHERE t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY) SELECT p.article_id, COUNT(q.customer_id) * 1.0 / (COUNT(*) + 5.0) AS ag_rebuy_conv7 FROM p LEFT JOIN q ON q.customer_id = p.customer_id AND q.article_id = p.article_id GROUP BY p.article_id;"},
{"name": "item_lastday_ratio", "idea": "Smoothed ratio of the article's distinct buyers on the last day before the anchor to its daily average over 7 days, flagging items that are surging or selling out right before the target week.", "level": "article", "sql": "SELECT article_id, (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 1 DAY THEN customer_id END) + 1.0) * 7.0 / (COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) + 7.0) AS ag_lastday_ratio FROM tx WHERE t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY article_id;"},
{"name": "user_mainstream90", "idea": "Mean log 90-day buyer count of the articles in the user's 90-day rows, a mainstream-versus-niche trait that interacts with global_rank and i_buyers7 to decide how far to trust the global candidates for this user.", "level": "customer", "sql": "WITH ib AS (SELECT article_id, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS n FROM tx WHERE t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY article_id) SELECT t.customer_id, AVG(LN(1.0 + ib.n)) AS ag_u_mainstream90 FROM tx t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.customer_id JOIN ib ON ib.article_id = t.article_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY GROUP BY t.customer_id;"},
{"name": "last_visit_type_match", "idea": "Count of rows on the user's most recent purchase day that are other articles of the candidate's product_type_no, an intent signal from the latest shopping session that is not smoothed over weeks like the 28-day affinity counts.", "level": "pair", "sql": "WITH ut AS (SELECT t.customer_id, t.article_id, t.t_dat, a.product_type_no FROM tx t JOIN users u ON t.customer_id = u.customer_id JOIN articles a ON t.article_id = a.article_id WHERE t.t_dat >= DATE '{A}' - INTERVAL 90 DAY), ld AS (SELECT customer_id, MAX(t_dat) AS d FROM ut GROUP BY customer_id), lv AS (SELECT ut.customer_id, ut.article_id, ut.product_type_no FROM ut JOIN ld ON ld.customer_id = ut.customer_id AND ut.t_dat = ld.d), ca AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.article_id, a.product_type_no FROM cand c JOIN articles a ON c.article_id = a.article_id) SELECT ca.customer_id, ca.article_id, COUNT(lv.article_id) AS ag_lastvisit_type FROM ca LEFT JOIN lv ON lv.customer_id = ca.customer_id AND lv.product_type_no = ca.product_type_no AND lv.article_id <> ca.article_id GROUP BY ca.customer_id, ca.article_id;"}]
